# 🥳 CozyUI Ex，CozyUI+ 的非官方擴展資源包

**English** | [簡體中文](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/blob/main/README_ZHCN.md)

![封面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jrC5r3Mp/images/37ebbcdd5ee29548fd194f5e292258055825afa7.png)

![GitHub 儲存庫星數](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=github) 
[![最後一次提交](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/commits/main/) 
[![自動打包狀態](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/autopack.yml?style=for-the-badge&label=autopack%20build&logo=github)](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/actions/workflows/autopack.yml) 
[![Modrinth 下載次數](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-ex) 
![Modrinth 追蹤人數](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/followers/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth) 
![Modrinth 版本](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=modrinth%20latest)

> ⚠️ 警告！！！
>
> 專案仍在開發中，部分細節可能處理得不够完善，敬請見諒 😥！
>
> **本專案已暫時停止。[了解更多](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/discussions/11)。**

> 請記得先**下載 [CozyUI+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-plus)**，然後依照以下方式載入此資源包……
>
> ![範例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jrC5r3Mp/images/c7e8d2e10416e33d8a8c35121849be9b9f1e366d.png)
>
> 除非你喜歡那種糟糕的體驗。

此資源包將 CozyUI+ 的支援擴展至更多模組，並支援愚人節快照特有的介面 _(例如 25w14craftmine)_

## ⬇️ 下載

您可以在 [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-ex) 上下載此資源包的最新版本！*(推薦)*

想要更*每日構建*的版本？可在此處取得此資源包的自動打包版本 [此處](https://nightly.link/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/workflows/autopack/main/)！ 

## 🖊️ 額外支援

請參閱：https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/wiki/Extra-Support

## ❓ 常見問題

請參閱：https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/wiki/FAQ

- [Fogg05](https://modrinth.com/user/Fogg05)：CozyUI+ 的原始作者，安息 2025
